title: The Restless Ghost
start: Speak to Father Aereck in the Lumbridge Church, east of Lumbridge Castle.

rewards.t: 5 Ancient bones giving 200 Prayer experience each
Access to gravestone upgrades by talking to Father Aereck

steps.t: Talk to Father Aereck in Lumbridge Church. [Chat: 3 I'm looking for a quest! › Accept]
Go through the graveyard's southern exit and follow the shore to a mining site. Head west to a hut in the swamp.
Talk to Father Urhney inside the hut. [Chat: 2 Father Aereck sent me to talk to you. › 1 A ghost is haunting his graveyard.]
Go back to the graveyard and open a coffin located south of the catacombs.
Equip the Ghostspeak amulet and talk to the ghost. [Chat: 1 Yep. Now, tell me what the problem is.]
Head back through the southern gate of the graveyard, keep walking until you reach the mining site once again.
Look south-east of the mining site, there are some rocks. Search the rocks, you will receive a muddy skull.
Kill the skeleton or run away.
Go back to the graveyard, reopen the coffin and use the skull on the open coffin. [Chat: 1 Put the skull in the coffin.]
